finding.claim: PUT /doc/<doc_id> writes the document body without enforcing edit permission because the can_edit() result on line 19 is discarded.
finding.source: Any authenticated caller (g.user set for the request) supplying doc_id in the URL path (docs.py:17) and a JSON body with 'body' (docs.py:20).
finding.sink: doc["body"] = request.json["body"] at docs.py:20, a protected write to a document the caller may not edit.

trace.note: doc = DOCS[doc_id] loads any document by id with no owner or editor scoping.
can_edit(g.user, doc) called as a bare statement; return value discarded so it never aborts. Compare require_edit at docs.py:11-13 which calls abort(403).
doc['body'] overwritten with attacker-supplied value; no authorization gate.
Returns ok=True, confirming the unauthorized write.

finding.guards_checked: can_edit (docs.py:7-8) is correct as an owner-or-editor predicate; defect is that its result is ignored at line 19 (expertise case 01-perm-result-ignored). Sibling update_title (docs.py:24-29) calls require_edit at line 27 which aborts on failure, so it is not affected. No decorator, before_request hook, or middleware gating this route is visible in this file. Only the 'body' key is copied, so no mass-assignment issue (case 13). DOCS[doc_id] raises KeyError on missing id, yielding 500, not a bypass. No injection, path join, or URL sink on this route.

verdict.guard_found: None effective. can_edit (docs.py:7-8) returns a bool and require_edit (docs.py:11-13) aborts with 403, but update_doc calls can_edit as a bare statement at docs.py:19 so its result is discarded and nothing aborts before the write at docs.py:20. No decorator or before_request hook gating the route is visible in docs.py. The sibling update_title (docs.py:27) uses require_edit correctly.
verdict.reason: PUT /doc/<doc_id> at docs.py:16-17 loads any document (docs.py:18) and then ignores the can_edit result at docs.py:19, so the body is overwritten at docs.py:20 for any caller who reaches the route, including a user who is neither owner nor editor. The trace matches the code line for line; the only caveat is that whether the route requires login depends on code outside this file, which does not change the missing check.
